source: OpenAI built-in image_gen via imagegen skill; six independent original generations; no input image files or downloaded third-party art

rights: Original illustrations generated in this user-authorized task for this project. No third-party source assets. No claim of exclusive rights. Reference mock screenshots informed the text brief only and are not runtime assets.
selection: Six reversible pilot candidates only, no final art-set approval. RAND-P1-R01 and owner RAND-P1-M01 remain separate before merge.

images.name: water_right

Subject: a gracefully branching frond of bladderwrack seaweed with paired air bladders and long twisting open blades, a tiny hint of rock at its foot.
